Titles.eng: The Hidden Dungeon Only I Can Enter
Titles.jpn: 俺だけ入れる隠しダンジョン

Summaries.eng: The Hidden Dungeon is a place of legend where rare treasures and items are hidden. Nor, the third son of an impoverished noble family who's lost the one job offer he had, was lucky enough to hear about this dungeon. He then acquires a skill that allows him to create, bestow, and edit skills... and in order to use it, he needs to accumulate points by carrying out such tasks as eating delicious meals and doing sexual things with alluring members of the opposite sex.
Summaries.jpn:
幸運にもその扉を開いたのは、貧乏貴族の三男ノル・スタルジアだった。
迷宮内に囚われた伝説の冒険者オリヴィア・サーヴァントに出会い、
ノルは強力な三つのスキルを授かる。

スキルを自由に作れる【創作】
スキルを与えられる【付与】
スキルを改変できる【編集】

ただし、使用するには「LP」と呼ばれる生命力を使用しなければならなかった。
〈性欲〉〈食欲〉〈物欲〉を満たしてLPを高め、「世界最強」のスキルを使いこなせ！

Aliases: Ore dake Haireru Kakushi Dungeon - Kossori Kitaete Sekai Saikyou
Special Training in the Secret Dungeon

Titles.jpn: ドキドキ! ミニミニ! 隠しダンジョン劇場 - 1

Noir, ever the polite and composed individual, responds with his characteristic calmness. The episode concludes with Olivia playfully kissing Noir on the cheek, marking a flirtatious moment between the characters.

Titles.eng: Doki Doki! Mini Mini! Hidden Dungeon Theater #9: Leila's Special Training
Titles.jpn: ドキドキ! ミニミニ! 隠しダンジョン劇場 - 9

Summaries.eng: Noir undergoes special training under Leila's guidance. The session begins with Leila emphasizing the importance of basic form, though she notes that real combat situations may differ. Noir, ever the diligent student, responds affirmatively. Leila apologizes for any odor, but Noir reassures her, mentioning a floral scent. The training continues with Leila instructing Noir on throwing techniques, encouraging him to proceed at his own pace. As the session progresses, the atmosphere becomes more intimate, leading to a playful exchange between the characters. The episode concludes with a humorous twist, highlighting the comedic and lighthearted nature of the series.

Titles.eng: Doki Doki! Mini Mini! Hidden Dungeon Theater #10: Luna's Savings
Titles.jpn: ドキドキ! ミニミニ! 隠しダンジョン劇場 - 10

Summaries.eng: Noir and Luna discuss the concept of "Luna's savings." Luna proposes that 30% of the LP Noir gathers should be used to create skills for her, while the remaining can be used by Noir. She encourages Noir to "make good use" of her, leading to a humorous and flirtatious interaction between the two. The episode concludes with Luna teasing Noir about his newfound hobby.

Titles.eng: Doki Doki! Mini Mini! Hidden Dungeon Theater #11: Beautiful-Girl Onigiri
Titles.jpn: ドキドキ! ミニミニ! 隠しダンジョン劇場 - 11

Summaries.eng: Noir and his companions—Emma and Alice—celebrate the success of their shop. Noir, feeling the exhaustion of the day's work, is offered assistance by Emma, who suggests a hug to alleviate his fatigue. Alice, not to be outdone, proposes that skinship is natural since they are family. The situation escalates into a playful competition between Emma and Alice, each trying to outdo the other in offering comfort to Noir. Amidst the playful banter, Noir, ever the opportunist, suggests they make "beautiful-girl onigiri," a term that piques the interest of both Emma and Alice. The episode concludes with Noir expressing his gratitude, stating, "Thank you very much!"

Titles.eng: Doki Doki! Mini Mini! Hidden Dungeon Theater #12: Olivia's Ambition
Titles.jpn: ドキドキ! ミニミニ! 隠しダンジョン劇場 - 12

Summaries.eng: Noir finally gathers enough LP to free his master, Olivia. However, upon her release, Olivia reveals that she enjoys being chained due to her 200-year confinement, leading to a humorous exchange between the two. Lola, an adventurer, tests Olivia's identity by asking her to touch an appraisal book, confirming Olivia's legendary status. Olivia proudly declares herself as the beautiful and powerful Olivia Servant, challenging anyone who desires Noir to defeat her first. Noir, taken aback by her boldness, questions if she's a demon lord. The episode concludes with Olivia kissing Noir on the cheek, marking a playful and flirtatious moment between the characters.

Titles.eng: Spira Spica x The Hidden Dungeon Only I Can Enter
Titles.jpn: ドキドキ! ミニミニ! 隠しダンジョン劇場 - feat. スピラ・スピカ

Titles.eng: Powerful Skill Set
Titles.jpn: 強烈スキルセット

Summaries.eng: Noir is the 3rd son of a poor noble and his job position is taken away by a more powerful noble. He also sadly lacks enough skills to attend the Hero Academy. He tries to find a way to be able to use his skill [Great Sage] better and stumbles across a hidden dungeon.
Summaries.jpn:
上位貴族に就職先を奪われた貧乏貴族の三男ノル。
英雄学校へ進学しようにも実力が足りない。
スキル【大賢者】で能力を上げる方法を探ると、
「隠しダンジョン」に辿り着く。

Titles.eng: The Guild and the Receptionist
Titles.jpn: ギルドと受付嬢

Summaries.eng: In order to find a way to earn enough money for the enrollment fee to the Hero Academy, Noir visits the Adventurers' Guild. However, the receptionist at the guild, Lola, doubts his skills, so he has to prove himself. Once she finds out he's telling the truth, she's supposed to offer him a reward, and...
Summaries.jpn:
英雄学校の入学金を調達するため、ノルは冒険者ギルドを訪れる。
しかし、受付嬢のローラに所持スキルを疑われ、真偽を鑑定することに。
疑いを晴らせば、ごほうびが……!?

Titles.eng: The Troubled Classmate
Titles.jpn: ワケあり同級生

Summaries.eng: Noir finds out the social ladder at the Hero Academy. A duke's daughter named Maria is the only one who gives him a helping hand. But he finds out that she has a curse that will kill her when she turns 16.
Summaries.jpn:
英雄学校で格差という現実を目の当たりにするノル。
公爵令嬢のマリアだけは分け隔てなくノルに手を差し伸べて
くれるのだが、彼女には16歳で死ぬ呪いが掛けられていた。

Titles.eng: The Untainted Cleric
Titles.jpn: 穢れなき聖女

Summaries.eng: Right before his meeting with Luna, Noir goes to visit Olivia. He asks her if there's a more effective way to gain LP and she tells him about a forbidden skill that will make him very lucky in the most unexpected way.
Summaries.jpn:
ルナとの面会の直前、ノルはオリヴィアの元を訪れる。
LPを効率よく稼ぐ方法について尋ねると、禁断のスキルがあるという。
それは【ラッキースケベ】というスキルで……。

Titles.eng: The Future of This Harem
Titles.jpn: ハーレムの行く末

Summaries.eng: In order to gain LP and money, Noir and the others enter a harem tournament. In this tournament, contestants show off their harems to be judged by a harsh crowd. Noir gets close with Emma, Lola, and Luna in order to try to impress the judges and win!
Summaries.jpn:
LPと所持金を稼ぐため、ハーレム自慢大会に出場するノル。
ハーレムを見せつけては罵声を浴びせられるこの大会。
エマ、ローラ、ルナといちゃつきまくって、優勝を目指す！

Titles.eng: The Tulip Lion
Titles.jpn: チューリップライオン

Summaries.eng: Noir successfully cures Maria's curse and receives a mountain of cash and decides to build a shop that sells rare materials, so he goes to the dungeon to gather said materials. He travels further down and meets a lion that apparently speaks human words.
Summaries.jpn:
マリアの呪いを解き莫大な謝礼金を手に入れたノルは、
素材屋を開業するために隠しダンジョンの新たな階層へ向かう。
すると、人語を話す魔物からある依頼をされるのだった。

Titles.eng: The Receptionist Ranking
Titles.jpn: 受付嬢ランキング

Summaries.eng: Lola gets in an argument with a rival receptionist. Noir visits the Adventurers Guild and ends up getting caught in their fight. Noir decides to take down a dragon both for his test and for Lola, but...
Summaries.jpn:
ライバル受付嬢と言い争うローラ。
試験に備えるノルが冒険者ギルドを訪れると、
喧嘩はノルを巡る争いに発展。
ノルはローラと試験のためにドラゴン討伐を目指すのだが……。

Titles.eng: A Little Girl's Wish
Titles.jpn: 幼女のお願い

Summaries.eng: Noir arrives at the 7th floor of the dungeon and he runs into a mysterious spirit who happens to look a lot like Emma when she was younger. Apparently, the spirit is having her life sucked away by something creepy and asks Noir to defeat it in exchange for a treasure.
Summaries.jpn:
隠しダンジョンの7層に着いたノルは、
幼い頃のエマに似た謎の精霊に遭遇。
彼女は“いやらしいモノ”に魔力を奪われているといい、
ノルは宝と引き換えに討伐を依頼される。

Titles.eng: To the Gala
Titles.jpn: 夜会へゴー

Summaries.eng: Noir is invited to a high society party by Emma. The party is in a stir when thieves proclaim to visit it and steal away a few things that are there, but then Noir participates in a dance battle against a noble to win Emma's honor.
Summaries.jpn:
エマに誘われ、社交パーティにやってきたノル。
会場は、怪盗から予告状が届いたため厳戒態勢が敷かれていた。
そんな中、ある貴族からエマを巡ったダンス勝負を挑まれる。

Titles.eng: Let's Go to the Hot Springs
Titles.jpn: 温泉へ行こう

Summaries.eng: The day for the Hero Academy tradition, their trip to the hot springs, has finally arrived! The monsters they face on the way to the hot springs are tough, but the boys in the class who can't control their lust are a far bigger threat. What should Noir do to protect Emma and the other girls?
Summaries.jpn:
英雄学校の伝統、温泉合宿が始まる！
温泉への道中に現れる魔物も厄介だが、
肉欲にまみれた男子たちも危険すぎる。
エマたちを守るため、ノルがなすべきことは……!?

Titles.eng: Noir's Decision
Titles.jpn: ノルの決意

Summaries.eng: The materials shop that Noir had been wanting to run is finally open. This all began after he met Olivia, so he wants to repay her by undoing her curse. He heads to the 15th floor of the dungeon and sees...
Summaries.jpn:
念願の素材屋がついに開店。
すべてはオリヴィアとの出会いから始まった。
恩返ししたいノルは、彼女の呪いを
解こうと隠しダンジョンの15層へ。
だが、そこにいたのは……。

Titles.eng: A Battle I Can't Lose
Titles.jpn: 負けられない戦い

Summaries.eng: The reason Olivia is so fond and protective of Noir is revealed. It has to do with an adventurer from the past. Meanwhile, Noir fights for his life against the fake Olivia. Will he be able to figure something out?
Summaries.jpn:
なぜ、オリヴィアはノルに親身なのか。
それは冒険者時代に起きたある出来事が関係していた。
一方、偽オリヴィアに追い詰められ、絶体絶命のノル。
打開策は見つかるのか!?
